name: W. W. Duncan
bio: W. W. Duncan of the Mandan furniture house of Duncan & Hilles made sales trips to Medora in 1884. The paper said he was in on the ground floor for furniture orders from the town.
mentions: Mr. Duncan, of the new Mandan furniture house of Duncan & Hilles spent Monday and Tuesday in town. He is well known all along the road and was very successful in obtaining orders.…
W. W. Duncan, of Mandan was in town on a business trip, the first of the week. He makes it pleasant for the boys and is in on the ground floor for all furniture orders from here.
Mr. Duncan, of Mandan, was in town a few days during the past week.
